projects.title: Nexpend - See your next spend
projects.name: Nexpend - See your next spend
projects.shortDescription: Track UPI, Paytm, GPay, and PhonePe spends — screenshot dump, locked vs play money, and what you can actually spend this week.
description: Nexpend is built around how people in India actually pay — UPI, Paytm, GPay, PhonePe — instead of bank logins or SMS scraping.

Most trackers show income minus spend. That leftover is misleading when rent, SIPs, and EMIs are already committed. Nexpend splits salary into locked money and play money, then shows the number that matters: what you can actually spend this week.
You do not type every rupee. Dump up to 10 payment screenshots. Nexpend reads amount, merchant, and UPI reference, skips failed payments, and skips duplicate UPI transactions.
features: Screenshot dump — drop or upload up to 10 GPay / Paytm / PhonePe / invoice shots
Duplicate UPI skip — matches UPI/UTR IDs, otherwise amount + merchant + date
Failed payment filter — money-not-debited screens are not saved as expenses
Locked vs play money — rent, SIP, EMI stay locked; Swiggy / OTT / shopping is play
Weekly spendable — remaining play money paced across days left in the month (IST)
Recurring bills — Netflix, rent, SIPs auto-log on the chosen day of month
Category budgets, monthly overview, charts, and INR-aware AI insights
Email/password auth (JWT), onboarding, light/dark theme, and a demo account
achievements: Shipped a wallet that replaces bank login with screenshot dump
Built duplicate UPI detection and failed-payment rejection so spends stay accurate
Designed locked vs play money to show weekly spendable after rent, SIPs, and savings

projects.title: TaskifyMinutes - Meetings into Action
projects.name: TaskifyMinutes - Meetings into Action
projects.shortDescription: AI-powered summaries, automated MOM generation, and smart task extraction — stop taking notes, start taking action.
description: TaskifyMinutes turns raw meetings into momentum. It generates AI-powered summaries, minutes of meeting, and actionable tasks from audio, video, or transcripts.
Powered by Gemini Flash and built on Next.js, it transforms conversations into structured insights in seconds — with a live demo you can try on the site.
Features include MOM generation, transcript generation from recordings, and zero-shot task extraction from natural language.
features: MOM generator — actions, decisions, and informational notes separated automatically
Transcript generator — high-quality transcripts from audio or video in seconds
Task extraction — identify and assign tasks from natural conversation
Live text demo — paste a conversation and see analysis instantly
Built with Gemini Flash on Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
achievements: Shipped an AI meeting pipeline from raw audio/video/transcript to structured MOM and tasks
Integrated Gemini Flash for fast summarization and task extraction
Designed a live demo so visitors can try the product without signing up
